pipeline.modality: Brain-penetrant enzyme transport vehicle (ETV) fused to iduronate-2-sulfatase (IDS)

indications.indication: Mucopolysaccharidosis Type II (Hunter syndrome) — neuronopathic and non-neuronopathic
indications.trial_design: Phase 1/2 open-label dose-escalation (n=47 primary analysis); extension study; pivotal Phase 2/3 COMPASS comparing tividenofusp alfa vs idursulfase in pediatric/young-adult MPS II
indications.trial_status: Phase 1/2 active not recruiting (NCT04251026); Extension enrolling-by-invitation (NCT06075537); COMPASS Phase 2/3 recruiting (NCT05371613); BLA accelerated approval pathway with PDUFA 2026-04-05
key_milestones: FDA priority review acceptance, July 2025; PDUFA originally Jan 5 2026, extended to April 5 2026
NEJM publication of Phase 1/2 results, December 2025
Royalty Pharma synthetic royalty agreement up to $275M, December 2025
COMPASS Cohort A (neuronopathic) enrollment completed December 2025
Commercial launch preparation underway; FDA Late Cycle Meeting completed and labeling discussions

indications.indication: Sanfilippo syndrome Type A (MPS IIIA) — pediatric
indications.highest_phase: Phase 1/2 (with planned Phase 3 confirmatory; potential accelerated approval pathway)
indications.trial_design: Open-label Phase 1/2 in pediatric MPS IIIA participants; CSF heparan sulfate (CSF HS) accepted by FDA as reasonably likely surrogate endpoint
indications.trial_status: Active, not recruiting (enrollment completed September 2025; primary completion 2028-08; Phase 1/2 on track for completion in 2026)
key_milestones: FDA alignment on CSF HS as reasonably likely surrogate endpoint, August 2025
Enrollment completed September 2025; potential commercial launch H2 2027
WORLD Symposium 2026 update: substantial reductions in CSF and urine HS

pipeline.modality: Brain-penetrant protein transport vehicle (PTV) fused to progranulin (PGRN)

indications.trial_name: Phase 1/2 study of DNL593 in healthy volunteers and FTD-GRN
indications.trial_design: Phase 1/2 multi-part healthy-volunteer + FTD-GRN patient study, placebo-controlled

pipeline.modality: Brain-penetrant ETV fused to acid alpha-glucosidase (GAA)

indications.trial_design: Phase 1 in adults with late-onset Pompe disease evaluating safety, PK, PD
indications.trial_status: Not yet recruiting (start expected March 2026; FDA clinical hold lifted January 2026)
key_milestones: FDA clinical hold placed December 2025; lifted January 2026

pipeline.modality: Brain-penetrant oligonucleotide transport vehicle (OTV) targeting MAPT (tau)
pipeline.target: MAPT/tau (oligonucleotide knockdown via TfR-enabled CNS delivery)

indications.trial_design: Phase 1, randomized, placebo-controlled in early AD evaluating safety, PK, PD

pipeline.license_origin: Internal (Denali); co-developed with Biogen since October 2020

indications.trial_name: Safety and Pharmacodynamic Effects of BIIB122 in LRRK2-PD

indications.trial_design: Phase 2b randomized placebo-controlled in early-stage PD adults aged 30-80
indications.trial_status: Active, not recruiting (enrollment completed May 2025; readout expected 2026)

pipeline.license_origin: Out-licensed to Sanofi for peripheral indications

OTV:MAPT, ETV:GAA, ETV:PPT1 and other TV cargoes (early/preclinical)
